name: TAG_SOURCEIP_V6
format: HELLO uses raw IPv6 blob 16B; Kad source publication uses CAddress 18B; consumers require a valid TAG_ESE_REACH V6_IN route before dialing

name: TAG_ESE_REACH
format: strict libreach v2 BSOB: version u8 + capflags u16le + nRdv u8 + reserved rendezvous entries/TLV tail; capflags bit10 is explicit ESE_NETLAB_V1 cohort participation and is absent without consent; source publication keeps classic tags

name: TAG_ESE_NODE_PUB
format: 32-byte Ed25519 node identity pubkey (TAGTYPE_BLOB); emitted and parsed next to TAG_ESE_CAPS in HELLO while the persistent identity is available.

name: TAG_ESE_KADIP_V6
format: <BSOB 16> network-order IPv6 of contact, observed-by-peer; Kad HELLO; additive, unknown-tag-ignored upstream; TX gated behind EseKadV6Tag pref (default off)

name: TAG_ESE_CHANNEL_PK
format: 32-byte Ed25519 channel pubkey (TAGTYPE_BLOB) in .emulecollection header; chains VOD collection trust to the channel identity. NOT in code yet.

name: TAG_ESE_COLL_SIG
format: 64-byte Ed25519 signature (TAGTYPE_BLOB) over the canonical collection transcript (MD4-sorted, incl. playlist order). NOT in code yet.

name: TAG_ESE_COLL_REV
format: uint32 catalog revision; anti-rollback mirror of the manifest TLV 0x04 rev. NOT in code yet.

name: TAG_ESE_VOD_META
format: per-file blob {ver u8, kind u8, date u32, duration u32, order u16, thumb_md4[16]+size u32}. NOT in code yet.

name: ST_IPV6
format: <CAddress> server.met v2 tag (moved off 0x91 collision with ST_VERSION)
